# WP1 self-test fixture: deliberately empty (no runtime deps). Exists only
# so has_python detection is true (see python-only/requirements.txt for why
# this fixture set prefers requirements.txt over pyproject.toml).
#
# Added during WP1's own Phase-3 adversarial review, which found the
# original single negative fixture (node-lint-violation) proved only ONE of
# reusable-pr-quality.yml's ~7 documented historical severity-swallow bugs
# (npm lint's continue-on-error) actually stays fixed - typecheck/test/build
# swallow (npm) and pytest/bandit/pip-audit swallow (Python) had no
# fixture proving they're still real gates. This fixture covers a second,
# different one (pytest's swallow) on a second, different stack (Python),
# to show the negative-fixture pattern generalizes rather than only ever
# having been exercised once. The remaining ~5 severity decisions
# (typecheck, build, bandit, pip-audit, npm audit) are NOT yet covered by a
# negative fixture - left as an explicit, recorded residual (see the WP1
# final report) rather than built out fully here, given diminishing returns
# against this package's time budget - not a claim that coverage is
# complete.
